newsitem.title: JAPAN: Indian Oil tenders to buy May crude--traders.
newsitem.headline: Indian Oil tenders to buy May crude--traders.

text.p: India's state-owned Indian Oil Corp has tendered to buy one million barrels of May-loading crude oil, traders said on Thursday.
The tender closes at 8 a.m. local time (0230 GMT) on March 26 and offers should be valid until 10 p.m. (1630 GMT) on March 27.
In the tender, Indian Oil Corp seeks to buy a wide range of crude grades including Middle East, West African and Asian oil.
In its April tender, India bought two very large crude carriers (VLCCs) of Qua Iboe as well as two Dubai cargoes.
